newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ratos to sell Scandic hotels unit.
newsitem.headline: Ratos to sell Scandic hotels unit.

text.p: Swedish investment company Forvaltnings AB Ratos said on Thursday it will sell a majority of its wholly-owned subsidiary Scandic Hotels AB to the public and institutional investors.
At the same time it is seeking a listing for Scandic on the Stockholm stock exchange's A-list.

Ratos said it would retain between 25 percent and 35 percent of the Scandic stock and would remain an active shareholder, but the divestment was in line with its strategy of becoming a pure investment company without wholly-owned subsidiaries.
The price of Scandic shares will be fixed through a process of tendering and made public around December 10. The price will be the same for all categories.
